//: Non-secret configuration. Secrets (store domain, admin token) come from env / GitHub secrets.
//requireAllTiers: true  -> a collection qualifies only when ALL three tier metafields are non-empty.  false -> any one is enough.
//onlyPublished: Only include collections and products published to the Online Store sales channel.
//publicationName: Sales channel checked for 'published'. Needs read_publications scope; if unavailable, the build falls back to the app's current-publication check and logs a warning.
//collectionExclusions: Collections whose HANDLE matches are dropped entirely (their own URL and all their 4th-tier URLs). Matching is on the handle, case-insensitive. prefix 'sale' drops sale, sale-women, ... ; use 'sale-' or regex '^sale(-|$)' to be stricter.
//seoOverrides: The 'SEO Tag Overrides' metaobject controls per-page index/noindex (default = index). The build drops any 4th-tier URL whose entry is Noindex=true OR has a Canonical Override, so the sitemap never lists a page that de-indexes itself. Needs read_metaobjects scope. Verify type/field handles with `npm run discover`.

sitemap.//urlsPerFile: Max <url> entries per shard. Spec cap is 50000; 45000 leaves headroom.
sitemap.//gzip: Write .xml.gz alongside .xml. Leave false while inspecting output on GitHub; turn on for hosting.
